purpose: Each mutant is a self-contained fixture (a pick `stream` + the `corrupted` served-claim partition a BUGGY impl would emit, breaking ONE invariant). bin/falsify team-copilot runs the gate against golden (expect PASS — the impl fold equals the independent reference) then every mutant (expect REJECT — the gate recomputes the CORRECT partition from the stream via the independent reference and diffs it against `corrupted`). Score = mutants rejected / total, conditioned on golden passing; a P0 gate requires 1.0.

mutants.name: double-pick-race
mutants.defect: two teammates both granted the SAME (team,issue) — the whole-sequence race a per-event 'each grant is valid' check misses (one-owner-per-issue-per-team)

mutants.name: cross-team-read
mutants.defect: a pick in team-beta is DENIED because team-alpha holds the same issue id — a cross-team read that leaks one team's claims into another's arbitration (team-isolation / rr-multitenant-isolation)

mutants.name: stale-claim-not-reaped
mutants.defect: a dropped teammate's TTL-expired claim is never reaped, so a later pick of the same issue is DENIED forever — the issue is wedged, never adoptable (ttl-reap-re-pick / handoff)
